title: X-LAB RT9
notes: International official page for the climbing-focused RT9: complete bike US$9,150 or frameset only US$3,499, with free shipping in the contiguous U.S. XDS carbon frame of Toray T-1100 + M40X, UDH compatible, about 550 g; XDS carbon fork of Toray T-1100 with 100×12 mm thru-axle; Branta carbon integrated cockpit; 27.2 mm XDS carbon seatpost; Shimano Dura-Ace Di2 RD/FD-R9250 with ST-R9270 and BR-R9270; CS-R9200 11–34T; Branta carbon power-meter crankset 52/36T with 29 mm alloy spindle; BSA 29 mm bottom bracket; SM-MT900 160/140 mm rotors; Branta C50 ULR carbon-spoke wheels (1,230 g, ceramic bearings); Michelin Pro 5 700×28C tires; maximum tire clearance 30C; 6.20 kg for size L. Four sizes XS–L; stack/reach XS 510/362, S 525/372, M 543/384, L 567/396 mm. The lightest-production-frame wording is maker marketing.
